title: Night Cream for Oily Skin in Monsoon: What to Use When It Is Humid and Sticky
ex: Monsoon humidity makes oily skin feel heavier and stickier. How to pick a light night cream, how much to use and what to skip during the rains.

rd: Night cream for oily skin in monsoon: choose a light gel-cream, use a pea-sized amount, skip heavy oils and layer less. Simple tips for humid Indian weather.
keyword: night cream for oily skin in monsoon
quick: In the monsoon, oily skin needs a lighter night cream, not none. Choose a gel-cream or light cream with niacinamide or aloe vera, use a pea-sized amount, and skip heavy oils and thick balms. Cleanse gently, because over-washing makes skin produce more oil.
